note: Lane exec_kite (app/kite_client.py, app/token_store.py). The lane has no routes of its own; these cases drive the paths that construct the desk's Kite and read through it (login_url, is_authed, the token store's key bootstrap) and, after the scenario, require the replay Kite's order/GTT calls to be EQUAL — none, since DRY_RUN never reaches the broker. place_gtt_stop/delete_gtt live paths are graded in tests/exec_kite.rs against a recording fake (and were cross-checked against Python's Kite with a fake kc); the weekly lane's /stops/arm is their route. /callback is the session lane's (not yet ported), so it is not graded here.

cases.name: login redirects to the replay Kite's login_url
status reads the session through the Kite wrapper
login again: one Kite per process, same redirect
status before the open reads the same session
status after the close reads the same session
status with an unknown query parameter is ignored
